$comment: Z Clear — notification status. Synthetic sample only. These are recorded provider outcomes, not proof of delivery; the sms_mock channel sends nothing.

endpoint.scope: Agency staff and platform admins see their tenant's outcomes. Importers see only outcomes addressed to them. Drivers are denied. Every query runs inside the tenant RLS context.

sampleResponse.detail: SMS mock: interface only, nothing sent
sampleResponse.subject: Review ready for shipment 0199f2b0-0000-7000-8000-000000000001

guardrails: No recipient email or phone is selected or returned by this endpoint.
The append-only outbox is never updated or deleted through the API.
sms_mock and mock record skipped outcomes and transmit nothing; real SMS and WhatsApp providers are roadmap and fail closed.
The screen says 'recorded outcomes only' so a skipped row is never presented as a delivered message.
